request.prompt:
Generate a beautifully restrained Chinese company-detail screenshot for the Client Reach Agent workspace, showing a complete evidence-based profile of 海能未来技术集团股份有限公司. Flat front-facing full-screen desktop 16:9, high-resolution crisp readable Chinese, designed at 1920x1080. It should be very usable, calm and simple, not a busy corporate dashboard.

SHARED SYSTEM: white and #F7F8FA surfaces, charcoal #20252C text, gray #76808B secondary text, #E7EAEE fine borders, extremely pale blue #EAF3FD selected state, muted blue #597FA7 links. ONLY black / white / gray / light blue; NO teal, green, colorful charts, gradients or dark panels. Chinese font like Microsoft YaHei / Source Han Sans, 14–16px body, 10px card radius, almost no shadow. All layout is content-driven, whitespace is intentional, cards adapt their height to lists, long titles wrap fully.

UNIFIED SHELL: 176px very pale gray sidebar, black square R logo "Client Reach" and small "Agent 工作台". Sidebar has EXACTLY "工作台", "查询结果", "设置", and "查询结果" selected. No other menu items. Bottom small "林 / 本地工作空间". Minimal 56px white header left "查询结果 / 企业详情", right "公开研究快照 · 2026-10-08".

TOP OF DETAIL: small back link "← 返回查询结果". Compact company identity row with square pale-gray "海" monogram, full title "海能未来技术集团股份有限公司", small chips "海能技术", "北交所 920476", "集团资料". Quiet outline actions "导出资料", "继续研究". Directly below title is a TOP DOCK segmented pill navigation, centered or left-align naturally within the content: EXACTLY THREE options "客户画像", "采购信息", "上下游关系" with subtle line icons. "客户画像" is selected pale blue, other two white with gray text. This Dock switches sections of the same company; these must not be sidebar entries.

DETAIL CONTENT: a 2-column flowing collection of 5 content cards, with generous space and natural unequal heights. The visual organization is lists and definition rows, no graphs, no score gauge, no giant statistic strip.

UPPER LEFT CARD "企业资料": tidy aligned key/value list:
"行业 / 实验分析仪器制造业"
"主营 / 科学仪器与分析方法研发、生产、销售"
"产品系列 / 有机元素分析、色谱光谱、样品前处理、通用仪器"
"办公地址 / 山东省济南市高新区经十路7000号"
Source footer "2026 半年报 · 企业官网 ↗". Let the product-series and address rows wrap naturally.

UPPER RIGHT CARD "经营与规模": three concise definition rows with the real scopes directly beneath values:
"在职员工 566 人" with "截至 2026-06-30 · 公司及控股子公司"
"2025 年营收 3.62 亿元" with "全年 · 集团合并口径"
"2026 上半年营收 1.59 亿元" with "半年 · 集团合并口径，未经审计"
Footer "2025 年报 / 2026 半年报 ↗". Numbers are clear but not giant billboard statistics.

MIDDLE LEFT CARD "已披露采购特征": 3 readable list rows with muted blue tiny bullets:
"采购品类：结构件、电子元器件、功能部件"
"按生产计划、BOM 和库存安排采购"
"关键长周期物料可采用年度订单与定期审价"
Tiny source "募集说明书 · 经营模式披露". A neutral small note "具体型号、逐笔数量与复购周期未披露". DO NOT fabricate purchase-frequency charts or product-match scores.

MIDDLE RIGHT CARD "公开联系入口": only two clean rows with subtle outline phone and email icons "0531-88874444", "China@hanon.cc". Caption "官网综合联系入口，不等同采购负责人" and tiny "截至 2026-10-08 可见 · 未拨号 / 收信验证". Footer "官网联系页 ↗". No invented person names, portraits or procurement contacts.

BOTTOM WIDE CARD "关联主体": a short 3-row list, optionally spans both columns and remains shallow. "山东海能科学仪器有限公司 / 实验分析仪器研发生产销售", "上海新仪微波化学科技有限公司 / 样品前处理仪器", "海能基石技术有限公司 / 基地项目实施主体". Small label "子公司资料；员工与营收按各主体口径". Footer "2026 半年报 ↗". Tiny secondary action "展开更多资料".

At the bottom one subtle line "每项信息保留来源与统计期；未取得的数据不补写". All key Chinese titles and real company names must be sharp, no text clipping, no all-caps marketing, no unrequested colorful charts. Make a refined complete customer profile where the natural cards carry all obtainable facts and the top Dock is clearly visible.

warnings: 第 1 张实际尺寸 1672x941 与请求 2048x1152 不一致。
